name: Public Data API
description: Public data API for Python and the command line: arXiv and OpenAlex papers, clinical trials, openFDA adverse events, World Bank indicators, weather, Wikipedia, Wikidata, Open Library books and NVD CVEs in one client, with one sign-in and the same JSON or CSV rows. Free and open source; runs on your QuanticData account.

commands.name: arxiv
commands.description: Preprint search on arXiv — abstracts, authors, categories and PDF links.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Free text, e.g. "retrieval augmented generation", or arXiv field syntax such as ti:diffusion.

inputs.name: category
inputs.description: Subject class, e.g. cs.AI, cs.CL or stat.ML.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.description: Result order.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many papers to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered papers.

commands.name: papers
commands.description: Scholarly works from OpenAlex: title, authors, year, citations, DOI, venue, open-access link, abstract, topic and institutions.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Search terms across title, abstract and metadata.

inputs.name: year_from
inputs.description: Only works published this year or later.

inputs.name: year_to
inputs.description: Only works published up to this year.

inputs.name: open_access
inputs.description: Only works with a free full text.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.description: relevance (default), cited (most cited first) or newest.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many works to deliver at most (1–200). You pay only for delivered works.

commands.name: trials
commands.description: Studies from ClinicalTrials.gov — status, phase, conditions, interventions, sponsor.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Free-text search term: a drug, disease or sponsor, e.g. "cancer immunotherapy".

inputs.name: condition
inputs.description: Restrict to a medical condition.

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: Recruitment status filter.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many studies to deliver at most (1–200). You pay only for delivered studies.

commands.name: fda
commands.description: Drug adverse-event reports from the FDA FAERS database — drugs, reactions, seriousness.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: A drug name, e.g. ibuprofen, or an openFDA field:value query.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many reports to deliver at most (1–500). You pay only for delivered reports.

commands.name: worldbank
commands.help: World Bank indicators per country and year
commands.description: World Bank development indicators per country and year, by indicator code: GDP, population, inflation and the rest of the World Bank catalog.

inputs.name: indicator
inputs.description: World Bank indicator code, e.g. NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (GDP in current US$) or SP.POP.TOTL (population).

inputs.name: countries
inputs.description: Country codes, ISO2 or ISO3, e.g. IT DE, or WLD for the world.

inputs.name: year_from
inputs.description: First year (default: all).

inputs.name: year_to
inputs.description: Last year (default: latest).

inputs.name: include_empty
inputs.description: Keep rows whose value is null.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many datapoints to deliver at most (1–200). You pay only for delivered datapoints.

commands.name: weather
commands.help: daily weather forecast and recent history by place
commands.description: Daily weather for a place name or coordinates, from Open-Meteo: conditions, temperatures, precipitation, wind, UV, sunshine, sunrise and sunset, up to 16 days ahead and 92 days back.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: City or place name, e.g. Rome.

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.description: Exact latitude (skips geocoding).

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.description: Exact longitude.

inputs.name: days
inputs.description: Days ahead, 1 to 16 (default 7).

inputs.name: past_days
inputs.description: Days of recent history to add before the forecast, 0 to 92 (default 0).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many days to deliver at most (1–30). You pay only for delivered days.

commands.name: wikipedia
commands.help: Wikipedia article summaries by search or title
commands.description: Wikipedia article summaries, by search query or exact titles, in any language edition: lead extract, short description, images, Wikidata id, coordinates and last edit.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Search Wikipedia and read the top results, e.g. "web scraping". Use this or --titles.

inputs.name: titles
inputs.description: Exact article titles or /wiki/ URLs to read, e.g. "Web scraping". Use this or QUERY.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Wikipedia language edition (en, it, de…). Default en.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many articles to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered articles.

commands.name: wikidata
commands.description: Resolve a name to a stable Wikidata entity id — the join key for entity linking.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Name or term to resolve, e.g. "Leonardo da Vinci".

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Language for labels/descriptions (default en).

inputs.name: include_details
inputs.description: Also read instance-of, country, official website, coordinates and image for each entity.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many entities to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered entities.

commands.name: books
commands.description: Book search over the Open Library catalog — ISBN, authors, ratings, covers.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Title or author words, e.g. "dune herbert", or author:, isbn:, subject: syntax.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.description: Result order.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many books to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered books.

commands.name: cve
commands.help: CVE records from the NIST NVD
commands.description: Vulnerabilities from the NIST NVD — CVE id, description, CVSS score, severity, CWE.

inputs.name: keyword
inputs.description: Search term: a product, vendor or words of the CVE text, e.g. log4j.

inputs.name: severity
inputs.description: Filter to a CVSS v3 severity.

inputs.name: cve_id
inputs.description: Look up one CVE, e.g. CVE-2021-44228.

inputs.name: known_exploited
inputs.description: Only CVEs in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many CVEs to deliver at most (1–200). You pay only for delivered CVEs.
